Boasting a private rear garden and spacious interiors, this home is an ideal find for small families, or those looking to downsize without compromising on outdoor space. The property welcomes you with a bright and airy reception room, centered around a stunning original cast-iron fireplace with decorative tiling, a true focal point that adds warmth and historical charm. Large bay windows flood the space with natural light, highlighting the rich, exposed original floorboards that run through much of the home. Adjacent to the living area, the modern galley-style kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring sleek cabinetry, ample workspace, and integrated appliances. It provides direct access to the garden, making it perfect for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The family bathroom is equally impressive, finished with crisp tiling and a contemporary white suite including a full-sized bath with a glass screen. The sleeping quarters consist of a generously proportioned main bedroom featuring neutral tones, high ceilings, and a large window overlooking the lush greenery of the rear garden. The second bedroom is a versatile space that functions perfectly as a guest room, a quiet home office, or a nursery, also showcasing authentic wooden flooring. One of the standout features of this property is the expansive private rear garden. The garden offers a peaceful escape with a mix of lawn and patio areas, perfect for summer barbecues, gardening enthusiasts, or a safe play area for children. This home offers the convenience of ground-floor living with a private entrance, dedicated front garden area, and easy access to local amenities and excellent transport links. Internal viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the rare combination of characterful period detail and essential modern outdoor living. LOCATION The property is perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of Enfield's vibrant community and abundant green spaces. Nature lovers will appreciate being within easy reach of the historic Forty Hall Estate, which offers beautiful parkland, lakes, and a farm, as well as the scenic Hilly Fields and the New River Loop, ideal for weekend strolls or morning runs. For fitness enthusiasts, the David Lloyd Club and the Southbury Leisure Park are both nearby, providing top-tier sports and swimming facilities. Shopping and dining options are plentiful, with the extensive amenities of Enfield Town just a short distance away. Here, you'll find a mix of popular high-street brands in the Palace Gardens Shopping Centre, alongside independent boutiques, traditional markets, and a diverse selection of cafes and restaurants. For daily essentials, several local supermarkets and convenient food stores are located within half a mile. +1 Commuters are well-served by excellent transport links. The property is ideally situated for access to both Enfield Town and Enfield Chase stations, offering frequent and direct overground services into Central London (Liverpool Street and Moorgate). Numerous bus routes operate nearby, providing easy connections across North London, and the A10 and M25 are quickly accessible for those travelling by car. Families will also value the selection of highly-regarded local schools in the immediate area, including Lavender Primary and Chace Community School, both within comfortable walking distance.
